# Zweikarta

> Zweikarta is an independent app studio based in Berlin, founded by designer Mohini and mobile developer Shrikant. We create calm, focused, and privacy-first mobile apps for everyday life. Our flagship app is GeldSpace, a wealth and net worth tracker built for individuals and couples.

## Flagship App

- [GeldSpace](https://zweikarta.com/geldspace/): A calm wealth tracker for iPhone and Android. Shows everything you own, minus what you owe, in one clear number. Features a unique "Mine vs. Ours" model where shared finances are tracked together while personal accounts remain strictly private. Requires no bank credentials or logins.

## Philosophy & Core Principles

- **Mine vs. Ours**: Financial clarity for couples does not require merging every bank account. Couples track shared assets and liabilities in "Ours", while keeping personal savings in "Mine".
- **Net Worth over Micro-Budgeting**: Rather than categorizing every receipt, a high-level monthly net worth check-in provides a calmer, more accurate indicator of financial trajectory.
- **Privacy by Default**: No third-party ad networks, no data selling, no bank account scraping. Data is stored within the European Union.
- **Two-Minute Monthly Routine**: Check in once a month on a set date (the "Money Date") with three simple questions, keeping money conversations low-stress.

## Core Guides & Articles

- [How to talk about money as a couple, without making it a big deal](https://zweikarta.com/blog/how-to-talk-about-money-as-a-couple/): Why money conversations feel heavy, three common patterns couples use, and a 3-question agenda for a calm monthly money date.
- [How to manage money as a couple, without merging everything](https://zweikarta.com/blog/manage-money-as-a-couple/): The three financial setups (everything together, everything separate, yours/mine/ours) and how to manage shared wealth while maintaining personal autonomy.
